5. Practice self-care: Maintaining healthy boundaries requires self-awareness and self-care. Take care of yourself emotionally, physically, and mentally to ensure that you have the emotional energy and resilience to set and maintain healthy boundaries in your relationships.

How can machine learning be used to improve the accuracy of medical diagnoses and treatments?

Machine learning can improve the accuracy of medical diagnoses and treatments in several ways:

1. Prediction of diseases: Machine learning algorithms can analyze large amounts of patient data and learn to identify patterns and markers that indicate the likelihood of a particular disease. 4. Clinical decision support systems: Machine learning can be used to develop clinical decision support systems that help doctors make better decisions about patient care.
